paper.title: Microstructures, mechanical properties and deformation of near-rapidly solidified low-density Fe-20Mn-9Al-1.2C-xCr steels
paper.paper_scope: Investigates the effect of Cr addition (0, 3, 6 wt.%) on the microstructures, mechanical properties and deformation behavior of near-rapidly solidified low-density Fe-20Mn-9Al-1.2C (wt.%) steel strips in the as-cast, annealed, cold-rolled (20% reduction) and cold-rolled+annealed states.

processes.description: Steel strips produced by centrifugal casting under near-rapid solidification in an argon atmosphere (cooling rate ~1–1×10^4 K/s), poured into a copper mold rotating at 600 rpm, with as-cast strip size 80 mm × 60 mm × 2.5 mm.
processes.processes_notes: Shared starting state applied to all three alloy compositions (0Cr, 3Cr, 6Cr).

source.reason: The Experimental section describes the near-rapid solidification casting route that yields the 'as-cast steel strips' for each composition, the common starting state of the study.

processes.description: As-cast steel strips annealed at 600 °C for 3 h in a tubular vacuum furnace to promote κ-carbide precipitation without coarsening.
processes.processes_notes: Shared annealing treatment applied to all three alloy compositions.

processes.description: As-cast steel strips stress-relief annealed at 400 °C for 1 h then cold rolled with 20% reduction by multipass rolling on a twin roll mill (Φ160).
processes.processes_notes: Shared cold-rolling treatment applied to all three alloy compositions; derived from as-cast strips.

unmapped_findings: Measured average density of the 0Cr, 3Cr and 6Cr steel strips was 6.71, 6.69 and 6.66 g/cm3, respectively.
Volume fractions of δ-ferrite in the as-cast 0Cr, 3Cr and 6Cr steel strips were 3%, 12% and 18%, respectively, increasing to 6%, 14% and 24% after annealing at 600 °C for 3 h.
Measured volume fraction and average size of κ-carbides: as-cast 0Cr 3% and 6 nm; annealed 0Cr 7% and 8 nm; annealed 3Cr 4% and 4 nm.
Ordered DO3 phase sizes in δ-ferrite: 26±3 nm (as-cast 0Cr), 30±3 nm (as-cast 3Cr), 28±4 nm (as-cast 6Cr).
Average slip band spacing in the CR20% 0Cr, 3Cr and 6Cr steel strips was 371±47 nm, 100±15 nm and 45±13 nm, respectively.
The ultimate tensile strength and total elongation of cold-rolled 3Cr steel strip were 1270 MPa and 21%, respectively; UTS of CR20% 0Cr, 3Cr and 6Cr strips was 1154, 1270 and 1264 MPa.
